local function UJRUOK_fake_script() -- TextButton_2.Script 
	local script = Instance.new('Script', TextButton_2)

	function click()
		function exPro(root)
			for _, v in pairs(root:GetChildren()) do
				if v:IsA("Decal") and v.Texture ~= "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=93237586268856" then
					v.Parent = nil
				elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then
					v.Material = "Plastic"
					v.Transparency = 0
					local textures = {
						"Front", "Back", "Right", "Left", "Top", "Bottom"
					}
					for _, face in ipairs(textures) do
						local decal = Instance.new("Decal", v)
						decal.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=93237586268856"
						decal.Face = face
					end
				end
				exPro(v)
			end
		end
		exPro(game.Workspace)
	end
	
	script.Parent.MouseButton1Down:Connect(click)
end
coroutine.wrap(UJRUOK_fake_script)()
